def getMaxRepetitions(s1, n1, s2, n2):
    len1, len2 = len(s1), len(s2)
    s1_repeated = s1 * n1
    s2_repeated = s2 * n2
    
    # Find the maximum number of times s2 can be obtained from s1
    max_repetitions = 0
    index_s1 = 0
    index_s2 = 0
    
    while index_s1 < len(s1_repeated):
        if s1_repeated[index_s1] == s2_repeated[index_s2]:
            index_s2 += 1
            if index_s2 == len(s2_repeated):
                max_repetitions += 1
                index_s2 = 0
        index_s1 += 1
    
    return max_repetitions // n2
